# External test data

`semif_authored144.jsonl` is the project-authored decision fixture from
[SemIf](https://github.com/TheoLeeCJ/SemIf) (`benchmarks/data/authored144.jsonl`), used unchanged
under its MIT license (see `LICENSE-SemIf.txt`). SemIf reports a mean per-family balanced
accuracy of 0.813 for Qwen3.5-4B (BF16) on it; `semif_eval.py` computes the same metric for this engine.
